verdict.rationale: Vanta documents parts of this story: offboarding employees in batches via its API (vanta-docs-23), collecting security awareness training evidence (vanta-docs-32), tracking personnel in audit scope (vanta-docs-29), and connecting to identity providers (vanta-docs-26). Together these suggest Vanta treats workforce lifecycle as compliance evidence, but nothing describes HR-synced onboarding or offboarding checklists, or proof that leavers lost access. Missing for 10: documented HR system sync, onboarding/offboarding checklist workflows, per-hire training completion tracking, verification of leaver access revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
